limitations: Run names in the RAW headers read '4231 TMTpro F016…F106' (fraction 01–10 followed by an autosampler digit). The R1–R3 replicates are IP replicates ('IP … in technical replicates') from nuclear extract of the same cell line, so every channel has biological replicate 1; the R index is in the custom column characteristics[IP replicate] (1–3) and in the source names. All channels share one MS run per fraction, so comment[technical replicate] is 1.
Channel labels use the TMT126…TMT134N terms (PRIDE label terms) for the TMTpro-16plex reagent; the TMTpro reagent is given in comment[modification parameters] (UNIMOD:2016).
The FLI1 IP was excluded from the paper's downstream analysis (low yield) but is annotated, as its channels are in the data.
Sex (male) and TC-71 age (22Y) are from the Cellosaurus records saved in scratchpad/PXD047503/evidence/cellosaurus.json; Cellosaurus gives no age for 402-91.
